card.name: Commercial sale and market words
card.fires_on: Words about selling, buying, or the commercial market, such as commercially, sell, customers, private (sector), affordable, and buying, in general web text. It fires where the next word is likely a sale or hire term.

modes.label: Commercial availability
modes.description: The word commercially before available, describing species or goods that can be bought.
modes.example: Each list contains<< commercially>> available species suitable for gardens and planned landscapes

modes.label: Selling and buyers
modes.description: Verbs and nouns about selling, buying, or customers.
modes.example: People give them away. You could<< sell>> them.

modes.label: Private or profit wording
modes.description: Words that set up business, private-sector, or profit contexts.
modes.example: Provide training for growers, consultants and IPM professionals in the<< private>> sector.

card.writes: It pushes toward sale and hire words such as sale, commercially, sells, and hire.
card.plain: It marks text about selling, buying, or the commercial market, where words like sale or hire may come next.
